name: Every Noise at Once
summary: Clickable map and ranked list of music genres built from streaming data, by Glenn McDonald.
description: Every Noise at Once lays out music genres on a 2D scan positioned by similarity, with a companion 1D list ranked by popularity, emergence, modernity, youth, tempo, duration and other attributes. Genres can be opened in Spotify, and a 2024 book by Glenn McDonald covers how streaming changes music.
contains: 2D scan of genres arranged by similarity
1D list sortable by popularity, emergence, modernity, tempo, duration and more
